body: Yorùbá is a widely spoken tonal language that depends on diacritics to avoid lexical ambiguity. However, it is often written without these diacritics, thereby hindering downstream Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. In this paper, we introduce Yo-ByT5, a byte-level Automatic Diacritic Restoration (ADR) model fine-tuned from ByT5-small. We evaluate Yo-ByT5 alongside five publicly released Yorùbá ADR models and one open-weight large language model (LLM) on the YAD benchmark under a consistent protocol. Our results demonstrate that Yo-ByT5 matches the performance of the strongest existing model, mT5-base, with a DER of 10.14% and a CER of 3.48%. Furthermore, it exhibits superior text fidelity despite using approximately half the parameter count of mT5-base. We also release our training code and model outputs, as well as call for the development of a larger, purpose-built benchmark for Yorùbá diacritic restoration.
summaryZh: Yo-ByT5 是一款专为约鲁巴语设计的字节级自动变音符号恢复（ADR）模型，基于 ByT5-small 微调而成。该模型在保持与现有最强模型 mT5-base 相当的恢复性能的同时，参数量减少了约一半，且在文本保真度上表现更优。研究通过在 YAD 基准上的严格评估，验证了其在低资源语言处理中的高效性，并开源了相关代码与模型，为约鲁巴语的 NLP 任务提供了强有力的工具支持。

glossary.explanationZh: 变音符号恢复，指为缺失变音符号的文本补全符号以消除词汇歧义。
字节级处理，指模型直接在字节序列上操作，无需预定义的词表。
词汇歧义，指同一书写形式在不同语境下具有不同含义。
Diacritic Error Rate，变音符号错误率，衡量恢复准确性的指标。
Character Error Rate，字符错误率，衡量文本生成质量的指标。
文本保真度，指模型输出在保持原意和格式上的准确程度。
